verdict.question: Is supply catching up to demand?
verdict.soWhat: NVIDIA's memory suppliers can cover 60% to 70% of what it asked for its next generation, so it is cutting memory per chip instead. Today's price sweep shows what that scarcity costs: an H200 still fetches $30,000 to $40,000, a single B300 about $53,000.
